texts.preamble: Ganaja Venkata Ramana Sunil vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 13 September, 2022 Author: Ninala Jayasurya Bench: Ninala Jayasurya In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya Criminal Petition No.7275 Of 2022 Between:- Ganaja Venkata Ramana @ Sunil And others ... Petitioners/ Accused Nos.3, 6 & 7 and The State of Andhra Pradesh represented by Represented by its Public Prosecutor. ... Respondent Counsel for the petitioners : Mr.D.Kasi Rao Counsel for the respondent : The Public Prosecutor Order:
texts.facts: 2. The present Criminal Petition has been filed seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.192 of 2022 on the file of Nandyal II Town Police Station, Nandyal District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 273 read with 34 of IPC, Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Section 24(1) read with 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and consequently direct the concerned Police to return the property seized in connection with the Crime.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioners while placing reliance on the decision of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.8.2018, submits that the matter is squarely covered by the said decision and the present Criminal Petition deserves to be allowed by quashing the proceedings against the petitioners.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioners while placing reliance on the decision of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.8.2018, submits that the matter is squarely covered by the said decision and the present Criminal Petition deserves to be allowed by quashing the proceedings against the petitioners.
